notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine legendary enchantments.
description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar nine times by sacrificing nine Spirits, adding {4}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Hei Bai.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
